description_zh: 阿里·阿卜杜拉·萨利赫（1942-2017）是也门总统（1978-2017）。他领导也门实现南北统一（1990），但随后陷入内战和部落冲突。支持霍塞运动，导致长期冲突。霍乱疫情在2017年冲突后爆发，导致严重人道主义危机。
description_en: Ali Abdullah Saleh (1942-2017) was President of Yemen (1978-2017). He led Yemen's north-south unification (1990) but faced subsequent civil wars and tribal conflicts. Supported Houthi movement leading to prolonged conflicts. Cholera epidemic broke out in 2017 after conflict, causing severe humanitarian crisis.
reason_zh: 萨利赫的治理智慧体现了部落政治和国家统一的复杂性。通过支持部落和Houthis，他引发了长期冲突。也门统一面临部落利益和地区冲突的挑战。
reason_en: Saleh's governance wisdom exemplified tribal politics and national unity complexity. By supporting tribes and Houthis, he triggered prolonged conflicts. Yemen unification faced tribal interests and regional conflicts challenges.
